_about: Shared contract for the submission video. Visual scenes (video/remotion) and audio (video/audio) both follow these timings. Change timings only here.
title: Second Look
tagline: Other tools summarise the record. Second Look checks it, for the task in front of you.

scenes.beat: Eight letters, one patient, different doctors need different facts.
Letters copy each other; errors travel (left becomes right), important facts vanish (-12 kg mentioned nowhere).
scenes.audio: tension, low drone; subtle tick per letter

scenes.beat: Anaesthetist types one sentence. Role and task are understood.
One screen: blood thinner, allergy, heart function, not documented items. Click a fact: the German sentence lights up with English.
scenes.audio: main theme; soft chime on source highlight

scenes.beat: Switch doctor, same patient: surgeon and emergency physician see different screens.
The record disagrees: 5 contradictions with both passages, blind spots, open follow-ups.
scenes.audio: alert accent per contradiction, then resolve

scenes.beat: How it works: AI points, code verifies; nothing made up; rules where rules suffice; built on IBM MLA output and the IPS structure.
Results on the 5 situations (numbers come from video/metrics.json) plus what does not work yet.
